due_when.clears_when: config/mandates.yaml's MD-PROMOTE-S1-S2 either carries a blocked_until naming a row that can still land, or has none because the operator armed it; AND bar.cost_tolerance_bps carries an operator-decided number or is explicitly confirmed at 0.0.

origin.ref: lane B5 mandate grants, session_01RAERa2sGmCEwSHRsAmwXrW, PR #12920, checklist row B5
origin.rerun: python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json'))" and grep rows D1/R1/D3 for their state; then grep blocked_until and cost_tolerance_bps in config/mandates.yaml and check whether either still names a dropped row or an unstated number.

what: Two numbers in config/mandates.yaml need an operator decision that PR #12920 deliberately did not make. (a) MD-PROMOTE-S1-S2 carries blocked_until naming checklist row D1, copied verbatim from OPERATING-PLAN-2026-09-21 section 5.3 (mirrored in CLAUDE.md and .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md). MEASURED 2026-09-25 by reading docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json: row D1 reads `dropped`, killed 2026-09-22 as a duplicate of R1; row R1 reads `done`; row D3's note records 49 of 52 comms/strategy_evidence records now carry a cost stack and that the corpus is no longer fee-only, priced on a flat 5 bps round-trip slippage. INFERRED from that, not re-measured: the block's substance may already be discharged by R1 while the block as written can never clear, because a dropped row cannot land. So the only mandate that can route real money is granted but permanently unarmable until someone decides whether R1 discharges D1 and what text replaces the block. Clearing blocked_until is the operator's act; a lane must not. (b) Section 5.3 requires the Stage-1 cost-fidelity clause to be checked against 'a stated tolerance' and states no number, and no operator decision sets one. The PR wrote bar.cost_tolerance_bps 0.0 on MD-PROMOTE-S1-S2 and MD-DEMOTE-S1-OFF as the strictest reading, marked INFERRED in place rather than DECIDED. Related but separately tracked: the cap as written (25 percent of the account's configured risk budget) binds MD-PROMOTE-S0-S1 too, which sits in tension with CLAUDE.md's 'Stage 1 may be wide'.
